scope: Publication privacy transformation of exported diagnostic identifiers only; private /tmp originals and frozen implementation/protocol/fixtures remain unchanged.
pseudonym_method: diagnostic-{thread|turn}- plus first 20 hex characters of SHA256(original UUID), consistent across both exports. Original identifiers and the raw mapping are not published.
archive_container: Deterministic sorted tar members, uid/gid/mtime zero, mode 0644, empty owner names, gzip mtime zero.
aggregate_verification: Exact report JSON equality after offline recomputation from sanitized exported members; no model calls.
